title: Temple Directory and Pilgrimage Planner
intro: Important Devi temples and pilgrimage destinations. A Shakti Peetha and a famous Devi temple are not the same thing: the `kind` field keeps them apart. No darshan timing, phone number or website has been invented — those fields are left empty until they can be filled from a current official source and stamped with a date.
editorialNote: Editorial content authored for this app. It has not been through independent scholarly review. See the Content Verification page.
